answer: When you sell us a car with an open loan, we confirm what you owe at the appointment and pay the lender off directly from your offer. The help center doesn't say how long it takes for the payoff to post or for the loan to show as paid off, so please contact a store about timing. Don't skip your next payment: keep making regular payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off, because a missed payment can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, the lender refunds the extra amount to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.

facts.fact: the payoff goes to the lender the same day, because Northwind Auto Finance is in the e-payoff network
keep making payments until the lender confirms the loan is paid off
